subject: DPA addendum & e-sign path for Nimbus Health onboarding
messages:
From: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@nimbushealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Sep 2025 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: DPA & subprocessors for onboarding

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We are ready to start the legal intake for Redwood as part of our pilot. Two asks to get the procurement cycle moving:

1) Can you share Redwood's standard DPA (or a slim addendum) we can review?
2) We need a current subprocessor list and confirmation on cross-border transfers (we process some EU patient-adjacent data via a downstream partner).

Our procurement team prefers DocuSign for signing but I can escalate AdobeSign if needed. Attached is our preliminary subprocessor worksheet (Nimbus_subprocessor_list_20250922.xlsx) — it's a high-level mapping.

Timeline: procurement is aiming to complete legal review by 2025-09-30 so we'd appreciate any redlines within this week.

Thanks,

Aisha Malik
Head of Vendor Risk | Nimbus Health
aisha.malik@nimbushealth.com
+1 415 555 0123

Subject: Re: DPA & subprocessors for onboarding

Aisha — thanks, and welcome. We're excited to get Nimbus onboarded.

Attached: Redwood_DPA_Slim_v1.2.docx (this is our lightweight DPA addendum we typically use for pilots; it narrows processing scope and includes standard EU transfer clauses). A few quick notes:
- We operate primary infra on AWS (US and eu-west-1 for EU workloads) and use a telemetry provider for anonymized metrics.
- We can provide a detailed dataflow diagram if your team needs it for the risk assessment.
- We support both DocuSign and AdobeSign; if procurement prefers DocuSign, we will prepare the envelope.

Could you confirm: do you need KMS/HSM attestations or a shared responsibility note in the addendum? Also, who in procurement should we route the DocuSign envelope to?

I'll loop in Karthik for any commercial questions and Marissa for legal redlines.

Best,

Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.ai
+1 650 555 0199

Attachment: Redwood_DPA_Slim_v1.2.docx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@nimbushealth.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 23 Sep 2025 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA & subprocessors for onboarding — redlines and questions

Aisha / Jordan —

Thanks for sharing the worksheet and Jordan for the DPA. I reviewed Redwood_DPA_Slim_v1.2 and prepared a targeted redline focused on subprocessors, data transfer mechanisms, and liability caps. Key items in the attached PDF (Redline_DPA_Marissa_v1.pdf):

- Subprocessor disclosure cadence: Nimbus asked for the current list; we can provide the list now but proposal is to keep the standard 30-day notice for new subprocessors unless it's a security-critical change.
- EU transfers: we include SCCs by default and operate an EU-hosted option; if you will be transferring patient-adjacent data, please confirm whether Nimbus requires data localization in eu-west-1 for the pilot.
- KMS/HSM: we can add language that we support customer-managed keys via supported KMS integrations (we do not run a customer HSM in our hosted plan by default — we can document options for Dedicated/Private deployments).
- Liability / caps: kept language typical for pilots but open to negotiation for production commitments.

We prefer DocuSign for execution; if Nimbus wants AdobeSign, we can accommodate but DocuSign will be faster.

I'll wait on your confirmation about localization and whether procurement can accept SCC + EU-hosted option. If you need a dataflow diagram, I can share one by EOD.

Regards,

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Compliance | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachment: Redline_DPA_Marissa_v1.pdf

Date: Mon, 29 Sep 2025 15:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA & subprocessors for onboarding — DOCUSIGN OK

Jordan / Marissa —

Thanks for the fast turnaround. Procurement confirms DocuSign is preferred (procurement@nimbushealth.com copied). A few answers and next steps:

- Localization: for the pilot we'll accept SCCs + EU-hosted option in eu-west-1. Please include the explicit line in the addendum that production data for EU patients will be pinned to eu-west-1 if/when we go to production.
- KMS/HSM: procurement doesn't require customer-managed HSM for the pilot, but may request KMS logs and an attestation of key management practices later.
- Subprocessors: the attached worksheet is purely informational; we need the current Redwood subprocessor list in the DPA exhibit. The file I shared is a starting point.

Can you send a DocuSign envelope to procurement@nimbushealth.com and to me (aisha.malik@nimbushealth.com)? We aim to get execution by 2025-10-02.

Thanks — I'll chase internal approvals if we see anything material in the redline.

Best,

Aisha Malik
Head of Vendor Risk | Nimbus Health

Attachment: docusign_envelope_987654.pdf (DocuSign envelope stub/link)
